theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_csfp_planes_eq_or_inf_bot
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (Q₁ Q₂ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (p₁ p₂ : Euclid P) (δ₁ δ₂ : ℝ), IsClosed S → (∀ p ∈ S, p ≠ 0 → ∃ (δ : ℝ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < δ ∧ Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 ∧ S ∩ ball p δ = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball p δ) → Module.finrank ℝ Q₁ = 2 → Module.finrank ℝ Q₂ = 2 → p₁ ∈ Q₁ → ‖p₁‖ = 1 → 0 < δ₁ → S ∩ ball p₁ δ₁ = (Q₁ : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball p₁ δ₁ → p₂ ∈ Q₂ → ‖p₂‖ = 1 → 0 < δ₂ → S ∩ ball p₂ δ₂ = (Q₂ : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball p₂ δ₂ → Q₁ = Q₂ ∨ Q₁ ⊓ Q₂ = ⊥
